notes:
What's new:
• After restarting the phone, speech works on the lock screen, and your main voice returns as soon as you unlock.
• Fewer silent stops: if a voice goes quiet after you swipe, MNS TTS now continues within 2 seconds.
• Arabic and other special voices: if one is slow to start, your voice for other languages reads instead.
• Reports now show exactly where and why a reading stopped.

If a reading still stops, tap Report a problem right away. Your text is never included.
